# BCGov Crow - v0.9.1

## Release type

Patch release realigning the Crow testing skill's CsCheck property-based-testing
guidance with idiomatic CsCheck usage. Removes a consumer-installed managed
template and a documented environment-variable switch, both of which fought
CsCheck's design. It also documents the release draft workflow's change-aware
gate so release preparation starts only for release-relevant changes.

## Summary

This release removes the `PropertyTestSampling` managed template and its
`CsCheck_Randomize` run switch, rewrites the property-based-testing guide
to use CsCheck's native `Sample` directly, and drops `AutoBogus` from the
skill's default test-data-builder stack in favor of explicit `.RuleFor(...)`
calls on plain `Bogus.Faker<T>`. 

## Highlights

- The `CsCheck_Randomize` run switch is removed. It existed only to opt out
  of the removed helper's exact-sequence determinism.
- The property-based-testing guide adds an explicit "What `seed:` does (and
  does not) do" section describing CsCheck's actual behavior: `seed:` pins
  iteration 1 only; iterations 2..N still vary across runs and thread
  scheduling.
- The guide documents a two-build strategy — PR runs at `Check.Iter = 100`,
  nightly runs at `CsCheck_Iter=1000` — with copy-pasteable PowerShell, Bash,
  and `dotnet test -e` passthrough commands.
- The guide adds a regression-pattern section preferring a hardcoded
  minimized-input `[Fact]` over a seed replay, and describes a labelled
  `Sample(..., seed: "reported", iter: 1)` replay form when a generator-shaped
  input is required.
- The managed-template lifecycle guide adds an explicit "When Crow removes an
  upstream template" migration path (Unregister then delete, in that order,
  for `Auto` copies; preserve-then-migrate for `Manual` copies).
- **AutoBogus is removed from the default test-data-builder stack.** AutoBogus stays
  in the detection list so existing suites are recognized, with a
  migrate-or-leave assessment (simple swap → migrate to plain `Faker<T>`;
  non-trivial usage → leave alone).
- **Crow's .NET default test framework is now xUnit.v3** (`xunit.v3` NuGet
  package, .NET 8.0+ / .NET Framework 4.7.2+, executable test projects on
  Microsoft.Testing.Platform). 

## Changes

- Removed
  `.apm/skills/crow-testing/templates/dotnet/generators/PropertyTestSampling.cs`.
- Rewrote `.apm/skills/crow-testing/modules/reference/property-based-testing.md`
  to use native `Sample`, add the seed-semantics section, add the iteration-
  count convention (100 general / 20 narrow / example tests for exact
  thresholds), add the two-build strategy with nightly-run command examples,
  and add the regression pattern for discovered failures.
- Updated `.apm/skills/crow-testing/modules/dotnet/unit-tests.md` to call
  `Sample` directly (no wrapper), omit `seed:` by default, explicitly
  separate CsCheck's seed model from Bogus builders, drop the
  `Bogus`/`AutoBogus` default down to `Bogus` only, and add a new detect-step
  entry describing the AutoBogus migrate-or-leave assessment.
- Updated `.apm/skills/crow-testing/modules/reference/test-data-builders.md` to
  swap the `AutoFaker<T>` example for plain `Faker<T>` with explicit
  `.RuleFor(...)` per field, delete the "Naming conventions for
  auto-generation" section, and tighten the "Thread safety" wording that
  previously referenced `AutoFaker.Configure`.
- Updated `.apm/skills/crow-testing/modules/reference/property-based-testing.md`
  cross-reference from "Bogus/AutoBogus builders" to "Bogus builders".
- Updated `.apm/skills/crow-testing/MAINTENANCE.md` trigger-table rows to
  track `Bogus` only rather than `Bogus/AutoBogus`, and to name xUnit.v3
  minor/patch releases explicitly in the non-breaking-release row.
- Set xUnit.v3 as the default .NET test framework in
  `.apm/skills/crow-testing/modules/dotnet/unit-tests.md` and
  `.apm/skills/crow-testing/modules/dotnet/integration-tests.md`; added a
  new detect-step describing the standard-vs-high-cost v2→v3 assessment
  along with a self-contained seven-step migration recipe (TFM raise,
  `xunit`→`xunit.v3` package swap, executable/MTP output type,
  `IAsyncLifetime` `Task`→`ValueTask`, `using Xunit.Abstractions;`
  removal, analyzer pass).
- Updated `.apm/skills/crow-testing/modules/reference/integration/fixtures.md`
  fixture and per-test-lifecycle examples to xUnit.v3's `ValueTask`
  `IAsyncLifetime` signatures, with a v2-signature note beneath.
- Updated `.apm/skills/crow-testing/modules/reference/reusable-test-suites.md`
  to note that on xUnit.v3 `ITestOutputHelper` lives in the `Xunit`
  namespace and that migrating suites can drop `using Xunit.Abstractions;`.
- Updated `.apm/skills/crow-release/SKILL.md`,
  `.github/workflows/crow-release-draft.yml`, and
  `.github/copilot-instructions.md` to describe and apply the
  release-relevant change gate before release preparation.
- Added the `Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.TrxReport` package to Crow's
  xUnit.v3 defaults in `.apm/skills/crow-testing/modules/dotnet/unit-tests.md`
  and cross-referenced it from `.apm/skills/crow-testing/modules/dotnet/integration-tests.md`;
  extended the v2→v3 migration recipe with a seventh step covering the
  package + `dotnet test -- --report-trx` invocation; added a new
  "CI test-result publishing (MTP)" subsection framed as "consequences
  of the framework choice," covering the Azure DevOps
  `.NET Core v2` `Publish test results` checkbox symptom and the fix
  (uncheck + add `PublishTestResults@2` VSTest/TRX) plus a pointer to the
  optional `Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.AzureDevOpsReport` package.
- Updated `.apm/skills/crow-testing/modules/workflow.md` Step 4 to require the
  Unit Test Organization Guide to document seed semantics, the two-build
  strategy, and the failure-pin regression workflow instead of the removed
  `CsCheck_Randomize` switch.
- Updated `.apm/skills/crow-testing/modules/reference/managed-template-lifecycle.md`
  to remove the `PropertyTestSampling.cs` example reference and add a "When
  Crow removes an upstream template" migration section for `MissingSource`
  registry rows.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.9.1 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.9.1.zip --global --target copilot
```
